    "chain": "Great Exuma => Gre + at Exu + ma",
    "reading": "the one who guards (Gre) at the altar (Exu) and invokes (ma)",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative"
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Great Exuma => Gre + at Eum + a",

    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative"
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Great Exuma => Ma Exu + tra",
    "reading": "the altar (Exu) of the mother (Ma) and the path (tra)",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative"
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "Great Exuma => G + E + X + U + M + A",
    "reading": "the earth (Gaea) expands (Exu) and unites (M) with the heavens (Uranus, Aether)",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative"
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "Great Exuma => G + R + E + A + T + E + X + U + M + A",
    "reading": "the gate (G) of revelation (R), the emergence (E) and truth (A) of time (T), the unknown (X), the earthly realm (M), and the afterlife (A)",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative"
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Great Exuma => Great (from Old English 'great') + Exuma (a Bahamian island)",
    "reading": "the large island",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary"
  }
]
